title: carex deweyana var. bolanderi
intro: Carex deweyana var. bolanderi, commonly known as Bolander's sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Bolander's sedge include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help in relieving coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
